subtitle: Portfolio and Dev Logs of Siddharth T (sudo-sidd)

posts.title: Pkmn True-Scale AR
posts.description: A true-scale Pokemon Augmented Reality demonstration built in Unity using spatial surface tracking and realistic real-world asset scaling.

posts.title: BumperBlitz
posts.description: Physics-based package delivery meets pure vehicular chaos. Deliver the goods, wreck the rest. Navigate the city as the most aggressive delivery driver — every third delivery triggers Takedown mode where you hunt and ram a target right off the map.

posts.title: The Last Train Out of Here
posts.description: A 4-day GMTK Game Jam submission. Play as a train conductor managing resources, passengers, and survival across 10 desperate days — accept refugees, trade at markets, and keep your people alive long enough to leave the country.
